title: Geometric reducedness detected by a chosen algebraic closure
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-pc-field-extension], let $X$ be a scheme over $k$ [def-weil-scheme-over-base], and fix an algebraic closure $\bar k/k$ [def-weil-algebraic-closure]. Then $X$ is geometrically reduced over $k$ [def-pc-geometrically-irreducible], meaning that $X_L=X\times_{\operatorname{Spec}k}\operatorname{Spec}L$ is reduced for every field extension $L/k$ [def-pc-base-change, def-pc-reduced-scheme], if and only if $X_{\bar k}=X\times_{\operatorname{Spec}k}\operatorname{Spec}\bar k$ is reduced. No finite-type, quasi-compactness, or nonemptiness hypothesis on $X$ is imposed; the empty scheme is included.

source.place: Tag 035X (lemma-geometrically-reduced), equivalence (2) iff (6) in characteristic p > 0; Tag 020I (lemma-perfect-reduced) in characteristic zero, together with descent of reducedness along the faithfully flat field extension k to its algebraic closure.

proof.text: If $X$ is geometrically reduced over $k$, then the defining all-field-extension condition applies to the particular extension $\bar k/k$. Therefore the base change $X_{\bar k}$ is reduced. This implication is valid for the empty scheme as well, since reducedness and the universal condition are both vacuous on an empty open cover.

Assume that $X_{\bar k}$ is reduced. Let $\mathcal U=X.affineCover$ be the canonical affine open cover. Base change of each affine open along $\operatorname{Spec}\bar k\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ is an open subscheme of $X_{\bar k}$, and these opens cover it. By [lem-trf-reduced-scheme-open-cover], every such base-changed affine open is reduced. If $U=\operatorname{Spec}A$ is one chart, [lem-weil-pbc-fibre-product-affine-spectra] identifies its base change with $\operatorname{Spec}(A\otimes_k\bar k)$; [lem-weil-pbc-affine-scheme-reduced-iff] therefore says that $A\otimes_k\bar k$ is a reduced ring.

source.place: Tag 035X, implication (6) to (7), and Schemes Tags 01I4, 01JQ, 01J2

proof.text: For each chart ring $A$, [lem-trf-reducedness-tensor-chosen-algebraic-closure] transports reducedness from $A\otimes_k\bar k$ to $A\otimes_k\operatorname{AlgebraicClosure}(k)$. The Mathlib leaf [lem-trf-affine-geometric-reducedness-criterion] then gives that $A$ is geometrically reduced over $k$, i.e. $A\otimes_kL$ is reduced for every field extension $L/k$.

source.place: Tag 035X, equivalence of affine condition (7) with all-field-extension condition (2), with Mathlib criterion

proof.text: Fix any field extension $L/k$. The base changes of the affine cover $\mathcal U$ form an open cover of $X_L$. For a chart $U=\operatorname{Spec}A$, Step 3 gives that $A\otimes_kL$ is reduced; [lem-weil-pbc-fibre-product-affine-spectra] identifies the corresponding chart of $X_L$ with $\operatorname{Spec}(A\otimes_kL)$, and [lem-weil-pbc-affine-scheme-reduced-iff] makes that chart reduced. Applying [lem-trf-reduced-scheme-open-cover] to the cover yields that $X_L$ is reduced. Since $L/k$ was arbitrary, $X$ is geometrically reduced. The empty scheme is covered by the empty family, so this argument includes it.
